description: Toggle talk mode on/off. Wraps `talk.mode`. Wire format (verified live against gateway 2026.4.12+): requires `enabled: boolean` — this is a SETTER, not a getter. Use `openclaw_talk_config` to read the current state.

enabled.description: True to turn talk mode on, false to turn it off.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

name: openclaw_talk_mode
